label: Construct a positive regress prefix bound from one shared law charge (inference)
rule: Use a fixed positive charge for every nonempty prefix and test the second extension
meaning: The charge treats every nonempty prefix as the same law event, so the prior only charges its choice once. The control isolates a coherent numerical assignment for any number of generated links. It supplies no identifying evidence that an actual regress is generated by such a law or that one law provides adequate explanation of a whole regress.
